recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Cream butter and sugars until light. Beat in egg and vanilla.
Mix dry ingredients; fold into butter mixture with chocolate chips.
Scoop onto sheet. Bake 350F 10–12 min until edges are golden. Cool on sheet 5 min.

recipes.name: Classic Vanilla Cake
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time, then vanilla.
Alternate dry ingredients and milk.
Bake in prepared pans 350F until a tester comes out clean. Cool before frosting.

recipes.name: Butter Croissants
steps: Make dough; rest. Enclose a butter block and laminate with folds (3–4 turns), chilling between turns.
Shape crescents. Proof until puffy.
Egg wash and bake 375–400F until deep golden and flaky.

recipes.name: Fruit Tart
steps: Blind-bake sweet pastry shell.
Fill with pastry cream (milk, yolks, sugar, starch, vanilla).
Top with glazed fresh fruit. Chill before slicing.

recipes.name: Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate and butter. Whisk in sugar, eggs, vanilla.
Fold in flour, cocoa, salt.
Bake 350F until set but still fudgy in the center. Cool before cutting.

recipes.name: Choux Pastry (Pate a Choux)
steps: Boil water, butter, salt. Add flour all at once; stir until dough pulls from pan.
Cool slightly; beat in eggs one at a time until glossy and pipeable.
Pipe and bake until hollow and dry. Fill with cream.

recipes.name: Lemon Bars
steps: Press shortbread crust into pan; bake until set.
Whisk lemon juice, zest, sugar, eggs; pour over crust.
Bake until just set. Cool and dust with sugar.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Make enriched dough; bulk ferment.
Roll out, spread butter, cinnamon sugar; roll and cut.
Proof in pan. Bake until golden. Frost with icing while warm.

recipes.name: Pavlova
steps: Whip egg whites to stiff peaks; gradually add sugar until glossy.
Shape on parchment; bake low until crisp outside, soft inside. Cool in oven.
Top with whipped cream and fruit.

recipes.name: Bread Pudding
steps: Cube stale bread in a buttered dish.
Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon; pour over bread. Soak 15 min.
Bake until custard is set and top is golden. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Shortbread
steps: Cream butter and sugar. Mix in flour and salt until crumbly dough forms.
Press into pan or cut shapes.
Bake 325F until pale golden. Cool completely.

recipes.name: Chocolate Mousse
steps: Melt chocolate; cool slightly. Whisk yolks with sugar; combine with chocolate.
Whip cream (or whites) and fold in carefully.
Chill at least 2 hours. Serve with shaved chocolate.
